title: Uncle Dan's restaurant and the fire
summary: Uncle Dan's on LaSalle near the Dew Drop burned while Cotton and his wife were eating there.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and the Prohibition-era clubs

blocks.x: Uncle Dan's, where was that? Was it near the Dewdrop?
Well, the south side, about two or three blocks down from the Dewdrop.

Where the south side used to be. There's a hotel right there in that block now, Rajon or something like that. Okay. And the cab stand used to be on the... It's second and... Second of La Salle, I believe it. Between second and third on La Salle Street. Okay. That's where Uncle Dan used to be. I think the hotel has taken it part where he used to be. A part of the part where he used to be. In fact, the day that it caught fire, my wife and I were in the club. We're in the restaurant.

And when it caught fire, the lady who was back there cooking, took water and threw it on the stove and the thing went really engulfed everything. I said, come on baby, let's get out of here. So she and I, we left. And I don't think they had insurance to cover. Mm-hmm. So that's when the place went down. It was internet storage.
